meta.subtitle: Path from html-doc to oku 1.0 — what's planned, in priority order, with the rationale and the open questions next to each phase.
meta.summary: Single source of truth for upcoming work. Tracks vision, phasing, and per-item status.

blocks.summary: The project is being renamed oku (Turkish 'read!'). The 1.0 push is ten phases — first the cheap cleanups already decided, then component bugs, chart interactivity, the reference rewrite, the Markdown converter parity push, the visualization expansion, the architecture / layout / rename work, and the top-level docs rewrite that closes the loop.
bullets: P0–P1 are quick wins: retire stale plan docs, drop the project-meta exclusion, fix the small component bugs the user has called out.
P2–P3 are the biggest authoring lift: chart interactivity (hover, shared cursor, true fullscreen), reference page restructure (pedagogical order, code/render side-by-side, viz grouped by family).
P4 closes every Markdown gap so 'Not in the converter' can come down. P5 unlocks every Mermaid type and ships the deferred Tier 3 visualizations.
P6–P8 are systemic: better architecture diagrams, layout option A, the html-doc → oku rename across CLI / packaging / branding.
P9 rewrites README + CLAUDE.md + index.json once the rest has shipped, so the docs reflect oku 1.0 rather than the migration.

blocks.content: Vision · oku 1.0: a documentation kit that authors single-source JSON or Markdown pages and renders them in the browser with no build step. Visual-first primitives — kpi-grid, table-with-chips, charts, mermaid, annotated-code — make long-form pages scannable. A single LEFT sidebar hosts both the site tree and on-page TOC. Multi-page sites get Pagefind search; standalone single-file output works offline. The Markdown converter accepts everything reasonable; no hidden information. The reference reads top-down by importance, grouped by family.

blocks.title: Phases
blocks.lead: Each phase ships as its own commit chain. Phases are ordered by readiness; the top ones are cheap and well-defined, the lower ones need design calls first.

steps.title: Cleanup
steps.content: Retire docs/plans/*.json (incorporated). Drop the project-meta .md exclusion (include everything by default). Fix the index.json CLI count (5 commands, not 4) and remove 'Open X.html' links — cards become click-targetable instead. Delete naming.json references.

steps.title: Component bugs
steps.content: ext-ref renders as a real <a> in addition to the tooltip. annotated-code: multi-line annotations stop overlapping the tooltip; substring annotations actually render. Kanban board view renders as kanban, not as a fallback table. Heading section gains its missing render result. View-toggle buttons become compact. Info / warning / tip callouts get standard symbols. Funnel labels and percentages align in a single grid. compare-grid loosens its item constraints and stops requiring a verdict.

steps.title: Chart interactivity + fullscreen
steps.content: One chart-tooltip controller for every chart kind: bar, stacked-bar, grouped-bar, donut, histogram, heatmap, treemap, waffle, radar, box-plot, bullet, slope, funnel. Multi-part charts (ridgeline, faceted) gain a shared parallel cursor. Quadrant chart labels and legends stop overlapping the data. Expand widget becomes a true fullscreen overlay with pinch / wheel zoom and drag pan, reused across image / chart / diagram / mermaid.

steps.title: Reference restructure
steps.content: reference.json reorders pedagogically — most-important first. Every primitive shows its JSON source AND its rendered result, side-by-side, in matching boundaries. Subsections gain card-style borders. The 19 chart kinds regroup into families (categorical, temporal, distribution, hierarchy, comparison, special) so similar ones sit together. Every missing render sample gets filled.

steps.title: Markdown parity
steps.content: Close every gap currently listed under 'Not in the converter': nested lists, footnotes, definition lists, reference-style links, inline HTML pass-through, YAML front-matter (becomes per-page metadata). Once shipped, the 'Not in the converter' card goes away.

steps.title: Visualization expansion
steps.content: Unlock every Mermaid diagram type and document it. Ship the deferred Tier 3 visualizations from viz-implementation.json (sankey, chord, parallel-coordinates, scatter-matrix, network, geo). Identify and complete missing capabilities discovered along the way.

steps.title: Architecture diagrams
steps.content: architecture.json's diagrams gain color, clusters, legends, hover affordances — bringing them up to the same visual standard as the rest of the kit.

steps.title: Layout option A
steps.content: Centered document with a wider default body. Sidebar variants per the layout plan (Option A), without breaking the single-LEFT-sidebar invariant.

steps.title: Rename → oku
steps.content: Introduce the oku package and CLI alongside html-doc. Switch the docs / README / kit headers / CLAUDE.md to the new brand. Decide on the deprecation window for the legacy name.

steps.title: Top-level docs rewrite
steps.content: Once P1–P8 land, rewrite README.md, CLAUDE.md, index.json, architecture.json, kit.json end-to-end. Single voice, no historical breadcrumbs, no redundant parts, every section earns its keep.

blocks.title: Principles driving the rewrite
blocks.lead: Rules the maintainer has set down. Every phase honours these.

items: Single LEFT sidebar — TOC + site tree stacked. No right TOC, no mid-edge tab.
Visual-first authoring. Pros/cons → comparison-cards, metrics → kpi-grid, trade-offs → table-with-chips. Paragraph + bullets is the fallback, not the default.
Plans, scratch, working files live under docs/ — never under _internal/ or in the repo root.
Every fix pairs with a regression test. Browser-level fixes ship with a Playwright assertion or, at minimum, a numeric bounding-box check.
Numbers in counters / badges only — no English words baked into the kit.
No demo sibling pages. Every example for a primitive lives in reference.json next to its heading.
No process / round / historical references in docs — the docs describe current behaviour, not how it got there.

blocks.title: Locked decisions
blocks.lead: Open questions that have since been resolved during the phase work.

items: P2 fullscreen: CSS-transform wrapper on the inner stage (not SVG viewBox math). Wheel zoom anchored at pointer; drag pan; pinch pan + zoom; keyboard +/-/0/arrows; reset button.
P3 code / render pair: 2-column grid above 900px, stacked under. Tabs widget rejected — readers want both views simultaneously for comparison.
P4 inline HTML: allowlist — a, code, em, strong, span, sup, sub, br, mark, kbd, samp, del, ins, abbr. Anything outside falls through as literal text; no script smuggling.

P5 Tier 3 viz: shipped sankey, network, scatter-matrix, parallel-coordinates as kit-native chart types. Chord deferred (niche shape, low reader value). Geo deferred (needs map-tile data path; revisit when an authoring need surfaces).
P8 deprecation window for html-doc binary: silent through 0.x and 1.0; stderr deprecation note from 1.1; console-script removed in 2.0. Mirrored in pyproject.toml comment + README + CLAUDE.md.
